title: Affine coherent log-ideal charts and their tensor-cover presentations
statement: Use the log structures, monoid group completions, fs log morphisms and coherent ideals of [def-trf-fs-log-blowup], and fine log structures of [def-trf-fine-log-etale-descent-datum]. For arbitrary schemes $Y,X$ with log structures $N,M$, a general log morphism $(Y,N)\to(X,M)$ consists of a scheme map $f:Y\to X$ and a map $f^{-1}M\to N$ compatible with the structure maps; equivalently it gives natural monoid homomorphisms on all relative etale test objects. The recorded fs log morphisms give such maps by retaining their data. Equality with a composite includes both the base maps and the maps of log sheaves, and the pulled-back ideal is generated sheaf-locally by the image of the target ideal. A fine (respectively fs) principalization of a log ideal $I$ is a log morphism with fine (respectively fs) source, principal pulled-back ideal, and unique factorization for every fine (respectively fs) test log scheme making that ideal principal. An etale log morphism is strict when its source log sheaf is the restriction of the target log sheaf; equivalently the section maps on every relative etale object are bijective. An affine ideal chart of an fs log scheme $(Y,N)$ and ideal $I$ consists of an etale object $W$, an isomorphism $W\simeq\operatorname{Spec}A$, an fs monoid $P$ and chart $c:P\to N(W)$, and a nonempty finite $E\subset P$ generating $I$ on all geometric stalks of $W$. Write $\alpha:P\to A$ for its structural map and $J_E=(\alpha(E))$. In multiplicative notation put $Q_e=\langle P,h/e\ (h\in E)\rangle\subset P^{gp}$ and define the saturated chart as the submonoid generated by $Q_e$ and all $g$ such that $g^n\in Q_e$ for some $n>0$. For any $i:P\to Q$, its tensor chart ring is the actual $B_Q=A\otimes_{\mathbf Z[P]}\mathbf Z[Q]$, with canonical maps $A\to B_Q$ and $q\mapsto1\otimes z^q$; tensors use [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. A tensor-cover presentation of $b:(Z,L)\to(Y,N)$ on such an affine ideal chart consists of submonoids $Q_e\subset P^{gp}$ containing $P$, open immersions $j_e:\operatorname{Spec}B_{Q_e}\to Z\times_YW$ covering the pullback, with their prescribed maps to $W$, and log charts by $Q_e$ whose structural maps are the canonical tensor monomials and whose maps to $P$ are its inclusions. Their intersections satisfy $j_e(\operatorname{Spec}B_{Q_e})\cap j_f(\operatorname{Spec}B_{Q_f})=j_e(D(z^{f/e}))$, where $f/e\in Q_e$ is specified by its value in $P^{gp}$.
